QuranEnc editions: preserve the publisher transcript and version embedded in each edition's _meta field. Terms: https://quranenc.com/en/home/about
1. Preserve the translation content without changes, additions or deletions.
2. Credit the publisher and QuranEnc.com.
3. State the publisher version number.
4. Keep transcript information with the translation data.
5. Report translation issues to QuranEnc.com.
6. Refresh the text when the publisher releases corrections.
7. Do not display inappropriate advertisements with the translation.
